emily: Heads-up: prototyping a tiny shim to allow streaming hotload of legacy .bin shard sets inside our safetensors pipeline. Need interface boundary check.
raj: quick q: is this for dedupe+index-first or purely streaming fallback?
emily: primarily for streaming fallback when manifest missing; idea: prepend a minimal sidecar header at request time that maps offsets -> shard id so hotloader doesn't need full manifest.
sasha: hmm, sidecar header sounds like manifestless index. How does it handle compressed shards?
emily: compress-handles: include per-chunk compression flag and uncompressed_length. Loader will call decompress per-chunk. keeps memory use bounded.
kevin: can we reuse existing WeightSource API? I worry about coupling loader stage to transport.
emily: plan: WeightSource stream -> FormatNegotiator -> HotloadShim -> RuntimeLoader. HotloadShim only exposes `fetch_chunk(offset,len)` and `probe_header()`.
jen: outline code:
```
if probe_header().magic == 'BINX':
  mapping = parse_sidecar()
  get_chunk = lambda off,len: transport.read(off,len)
else:
  fall back to safetensors.index_first()
```

raj: what about consistency when swapping in dedicated bundles? race with eviction.
emily: shim will offer ephemeral lease tokens. loader must call `lease(chunk_id)` before pinning. if lease fails, try fallback variant.
ops-bot: deploy-check: 2 tests failing in CI related to mmaped reads when header absent :eyes:
sasha: CI note: add unit for compressed-chunk read/decompress and for race with eviction.
kevin: performance risk: extra per-chunk syscall for mapping. can we batch calls? maybe expose `prefetch(range_list)` in shim.
emily: yes prefetch + async decompression agreed. also will add telemetry tags: shim_format=binx, fallback_reason.
linda: SGTM. Any security concerns? check signature verification for sidecars.
emily: sidecar signed with model key; verify before hotload. signature failure => immediate fallback and alert.
raj: ok if we add this as short-lived bridge; long-term we prefer canonicalizing to safetensors. add deprecation note in API.
emily: creating RFC follow-up doc with pseudocode and test checklist. tagging @sasha @kevin for review. Thanks!
kevin: ack. I'll add perf microbench tomorrow.
